subject: Kickoff: questionnaire routing & scope alignment for Finwell SOC2 / HIPAA checks
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Michael Chen <security@finwell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: questionnaire routing & scope alignment for Finwell SOC2 / HIPAA checks

Thanks for taking time today, Michael — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the compliance track for RW-2384.

Call recap (high level):
- Finwell is evaluating Redwood for low-latency inference in your care-management product.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 coverage, HIPAA handling (PHI in API calls), and GDPR/data residency for EU-sourced users (currently limited but want clarity).
- You asked about what evidence we can provide and how we usually handle SIG/CAIQ vs custom vendor forms.

Clarifying questions / asks from our side to prepare a prefill:
1) Questionnaire type: Do you prefer SOC 2 + SIG Lite prefill, full SIG, CAIQ, or your custom vendor form? (If custom, please attach.)
2) HIPAA scope: Will Finwell require a formal BAA or a narrower attestation? Is the scope only API/processing or also analytics/derivative datasets?
3) Data residency: Are there specific regions where data must remain (US-only, hybrid, EU)?
4) Evidence priorities: for our typical customers we provide SOC 2 Type II report (where allowed), encryption config summary (in transit/at rest), IAM/SSO details, logging/retention, incident response, pentest summary, and system architecture diagram. Which of these would you like prioritized?
5) Timeline: Do you have procurement milestones? We suggested a first-pass prefill and evidence bundle by 2026-10-22 — does that work?

Next steps we propose (if OK with you):
- We will send a SIG-prefill template and a SOC2 coverage matrix for your security team to review. (attached: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx)
- If you confirm BAA required, Ben (cc'd) will coordinate a draft for your legal/procurement team.
- Please share any custom questionnaire or specific evidence IDs (e.g., vendor portal ticket numbers) so we can map coverage.

Attachments: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake

Subject: Re: Kickoff: questionnaire routing & scope alignment for Finwell SOC2 / HIPAA checks

Jordan — thanks, helpful recap. Answers inline below.

1) Questionnaire: We prefer SIG Lite for vendor assessment to start; we can expand to full SIG if gaps remain. I'll attach our custom vendor form as well in case we need specific fields.
2) HIPAA / BAA: Yes — Finwell requires a BAA for any vendor processing PHI. Scope here is API traffic (patient identifiers and encounter metadata). No analytics/derivative datasets are in scope for now.
3) Data residency: Primary requirement is US-only for production patient data. Test/dev can be multi-region with redacted datasets.
4) Evidence priorities: SOC 2 Type II report (audit period last 12 months), encryption (TLS v1.2+ / AES-256 at rest), IAM/SSO (we use SAML SSO), logging/retention (ability to export audit logs for 2 years), incident response contact and SLA, pentest summary.
5) Timeline: Procurement target is to have security review complete by 2026-11-05 and contract signed by 2026-11-15. First-pass prefill by 2026-10-22 is fine.

Attachments: finwell-vendor-qa.pdf (our vendor questionnaire, marked required fields), procurement-contact: Sara Lopez <procurement@finwell.com>.

Michael Chen
Director, Security & Compliance | Finwell Health

Appreciate the quick responses, Michael — clear and helpful. Confirming next steps and owners:
- By 2026-10-20 EOD: Ben will upload an initial SIG Lite prefill (partial answers for technical controls).
- By 2026-10-22: Monica will attach the SOC 2 Type II coverage matrix and control narratives (redwood-soc2-coverage-matrix.xlsx).
- Legal / Procurement: Ben to send a BAA draft to Sara (procurement@finwell.com) for review; Jordan to share the DocuSign link when ready.
- We will map the finwell-vendor-qa.pdf fields to SIG/our SOC2 artifacts and highlight any gaps by 2026-10-22 so your team has something to review ahead of the 11/05 target.

Quick clarifying question for your team (so we map correctly): in the finwell-vendor-qa.pdf the "audit log retention" field asks for export format — do you prefer CSV or a syslog/AWS S3 bucket delivery? Either is fine for us but we'll prepare both export descriptions.

I'll send the prefill as a shared Drive link and attach the two files in follow-up. Thanks again — talk soon.
